stable.headline: Smart optimise scans first, a right-click menu in the colour picker, a cleaner look
notes: Smart optimise scans the model first and lists what it found, with Highlight and Isolate.
A right-click menu in the colour picker: copy, paste and the colour spaces.
Click a material to pick it, double-click to open it, Delete takes it off.
A saved scene reopens with the same parts selected.
A new black, flat buttons and one check box throughout.
The Quick wand is on Q; W switches the gizmo between World and Local.
